text: Security is an essential part of web development. Every website should use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and the server. Authentication helps confirm that users are who they claim to be, usually through passwords or two-factor methods. Input validation is also important because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must be aware of common vulnerabilities such as SQL injection and cross-site scripting, which can allow attackers to steal information or damage a site. By following good security practices from the start, developers can build safer applications and protect their users from online threats.
